description: Where an update did not hold: what putting the version it replaced back came to.

placed.description: Whether everything its record says it placed is on the machine again.

running.description:
Whether its containers are running again.

Apart from `placed`, because the two fail differently: a document that would not
land is a disk, and a container that would not start is the engine — and an
operator fixes them in different places.

version.description: The version put back, which is the one the record still names.
